stages.headline: The volume of a cuboid is the product of its three dimensions: V = abc.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a cuboid is the product of its three dimensions: V = abc.

stages.headline: Since ab is the base area, V = S(base) · h; for a cube V = a³.
stages.headlineEnglish: Since ab is the base area, V = S(base) · h; for a cube V = a³.

stages.headline: Examples: 2 × 3 × 5 ⇒ V = 30; a cube with edge 4 ⇒ V = 64.
